name: Entwine
summary:
What if bringing two characters together was also a puzzle about separating them?

Entwine is a cozy puzzle game where two characters move in opposite directions. Every move affects both characters, challenging players to coordinate their paths, anticipate their movements, and find a way to bring them together.

Built around the relationship between movement, distance, and connection, Entwine turns a simple premise into a playful test of spatial reasoning. Each puzzle invites players to think ahead and discover how opposing paths can lead to the same destination.
